name: [OGURI CAP MASTERY] Uma Racing
desc:
⚠️ JOIN OUR COMMUNITY SERVER FOR ANY GAME UPDATES NEWS ⚠️

it's uma musume but roblox
this unofficial, fan-made game was crafted to celebrate the series and welcome more people into our community

PC Controls
- Sprint :
     – Tap Q/E or M1/M2 repeatedly (Option 1)
     – Hold Shift + W (Tap Shift repeatedly for more faster sprint gain) (Option 2)
- R : Spurt 
- F : Ability
- G : Zone

Console Controls
R1 – Ability
L2 – Increase Speed
RB – Skill
LB – Spurt
LT – Run
Right D Pad – Zone
Left D Pad – Shift Lock
R1/R2/L1/L2 are used for the initial QTEs.
